description: This file implements the RemoteRemotelyProvisionedComponent class, which provides methods for interacting with remote key provisioning hardware, including retrieving hardware info, generating key pairs, and creating certificate requests. It interfaces with the keymaster and aidl hardware security components.

classes.name: RemoteRemotelyProvisionedComponent
classes.description: A class that manages remote key provisioning operations, including fetching hardware info, generating key pairs, and creating certificate signing requests.

methods.name: getHardwareInfo
methods.description: Retrieves hardware information from the remote keymaster implementation.

methods.name: generateEcdsaP256KeyPair
methods.description: Generates an ECDSA P-256 key pair remotely and returns the public key and private key handle.

methods.name: generateCertificateRequest
methods.description: Creates a certificate signing request (CSR) with specified keys and challenge.

methods.name: generateCertificateRequestV2
methods.description: Creates a CSR version 2 with specified keys and challenge.
